R4D-grouse-atv-0002.name: By Hoder Creek
R4D-grouse-atv-0002.pressureWhy: Busier: within 1 km of a paved road (estimate).
R4D-grouse-atv-0002.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (Slocan-Hodor FSR); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
2 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
27 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

flags.t: Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 4 table (pages 39 and 40), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis). Pages 36 to 41 print no LEH list.

plan: Drive: from Village of Nakusp, about 77 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 49.71808, -117.75482, where the truck road ends (Slocan-Hodor FSR); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: the Slocan-Hodor FSR stretch, 5.1 km one way. About 102 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-16, Region 4. No baiting in Region 4. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R4D-grouse-atv-0002.popWhy: Popular (more hunters): MU 4-16: about 4,040 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 2.22 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: close to pavement, a town or a rec site. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.0 km and about 0 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
